title: Fence Painting & Staining in Ocala, FL | Horse Country
description: Fence painting and staining in Ocala, FL for long board fences on horse properties and privacy fences in town. Washed, repaired, and coated to last.
h1: Fence Painting and Staining in Ocala, FL, from Paddock to Backyard
heroIntro: Ocala is horse country, and that means a lot of fence. We clean, repair, and coat long board runs on equestrian estates as well as privacy fences on city lots.

questions: Should I paint or stain my wood fence in Ocala?
Can you stain long fence lines on a horse farm?

sections.h2: Two very different Ocala fence jobs
body: Much of the large-acreage land in SW and NW Ocala is equestrian property, where fencing can run along pastures, paddocks, and drives. Those jobs are about production and consistency: keeping the same color and coverage across a long run, working around animals and gates, and planning access across the property. In town, from Silver Springs Shores to the older streets near Historic Downtown, the work is usually a backyard privacy fence where neighbors, landscaping, and tight side yards matter more.
Both kinds of work fall under fence painting in Ocala, FL, and the estimate is written for the specific fence, not a flat number per foot.

For most wood fences we recommend penetrating stain. It soaks into the wood, does not peel, and is simpler to refresh later. Paint makes sense when a fence has already been painted, when you want a crisp solid color, or for vinyl fences that are faded. We talk through the trade-offs at the walkthrough and show samples on your boards.
Sun-bleached, gray wood is common on exposed fence lines in Marion County. Our article on treating sun-damaged wood fences explains how weathered wood is brought back before a new finish.

Each project starts with a wash and mildew treatment so stain or paint is not trapping growth underneath. Loose pickets, split boards, and failing hardware are repaired or replaced as written on the estimate. Failed coatings are stripped where needed and rough areas sanded. Stain is sprayed and back-brushed so it penetrates; paint goes on in two full coats over primed bare wood.

For new pressure-treated fences, timing matters. Fresh lumber often needs time to dry before stain can penetrate properly, and we check the wood at the walkthrough so we do not seal moisture in too early.
bullets: Masking of plantings, structures, and adjacent surfaces
Stain sprayed and back-brushed, or two coats of paint
Labelled leftover stain or paint for future touch-ups

body: Fence work is easiest October through May, when wood dries quickly after washing. Work usually begins one to three weeks after you approve the estimate. If you also have a deck, our deck staining in Ocala uses the same stain system, so both can match. See our broader guide to deck and fence staining in Florida or go back to the Ocala painting contractor page.

faqs.q: Can you work around horses while staining pasture fencing?
faqs.a: We plan access and sequence with you before starting, so fence sections can be done while animals are moved to other areas.

faqs.q: Do you paint vinyl fences in Ocala?
faqs.a: Yes. Faded vinyl can be cleaned and painted with a product suited to the material. We discuss color and expectations at the walkthrough.

faqs.q: How do you price a long fence run?
faqs.a: We measure the fence and price it by condition, repairs, finish type, and access. Each property gets a written, itemized estimate.

faqs.q: Can you match my fence to my deck or house trim?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match stain or paint colors from a sample, a board, or a leftover can and confirm the result on your fence before the full run.
